messages:
sophie: Quick check — planning canary rollout for v2.3 to EU-west in ~30m. Need signoff on latency SLOs and perf sanity. Target p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 220ms, errors <0.5%. Can people run a 5-min perf-run on small/medium sequences and post numbers? I'll also kick the smoke pipeline.
arjun: I can run. Which workload and seed prompts?
sophie: Use perf/batches/seq_small.json and seq_medium.json. Command:
```
perf-runner --project=redwood --model=v2.3-canary --duration=300 --concurrency=8 --workload=seq_small.json
```
arjun: running now, will post p50/p95/p99 + errors
infra-bot: smoke pipeline started for v2.3-canary in eu-west (run id: smoke-331). Logs: https://ci.internal/smoke-331
arjun: results: p50 26ms, p95 115ms, p99 205ms, errors 0.12%
kevin: p99 under threshold but pretty close. What's current CPU on nodes?
infra-bot: node-metrics snapshot: cpu 68%, gpu 45%, queue depth 2. Trace link: https://metrics/trace/331
maya: seeing occasional p99 bursts correlated with cache cold starts. Suggest we increase cache warmup, or hold at 10% until we bisect.
luis: I can grab KV cache hit rates and traces. Which window?
sophie: last 10m from perf run. luis, can you collect traces + flamegraphs and upload to /shared/canary/traces/1765554321
luis: on it.
arjun: re-running with --prefetch-kv=1 to simulate warm cache. Results in 2m: p95 98ms, p99 150ms, errors 0.05%
maya: much better with prefetch. That suggests cold-KV effect; maybe safe to proceed if we set warmup param.
kevin: decision call — thumbs up to roll to 10% with warmup param enabled and k/v prefetch on. If p99 exceeds 220ms OR errors >0.5% in next 15m, auto-rollback.
sophie: agreed. I'll patch rollout config and start at 10% then 30 after stable 30m. I'll annotate the release ticket.
infra-bot: canary deployment started: v2.3-canary -> 10% traffic. env=eu-west. rollout-id=roll-884
maya: I'll watch traces for 20m and call rollback if anomaly.
arjun: noted. I'll keep perf bench running every 5m.
sophie: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
luis: uploaded traces: /shared/canary/traces/1765554321/ (flamegraphs + kv-metrics)
infra-bot: alert: within first 8m p99=238ms (exceeded threshold). Auto-pause triggered, holding at 10% and notifying leads.
sophie: holding and investigating, please don't escalate to rollback yet — let's confirm root cause.
maya: CPU spikes align with a kernel fallback on kernel v1.4. I'll bisect commit now.
kevin: if we don't find quick mitigation, rollback plan ready: revert to v2.2-canary and drain new instances.
sophie: update in 10m. Thanks team.
